title: The Devil's Mouth
plot_overview: A group of college friends on an adventure in Thailand become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As their oxygen dwindles, tensions from the past surface, forcing them to navigate the dark, confined passages and find a way to survive.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like shark attacks, underwater peril, and familiar survival thrills, especially in 47 Meters Down: Uncaged; Not for you if you want rich characters, strong originality, or consistently gripping suspense.
review_summary: Pros: claustrophobic cave setting; occasional tense moments; entertaining B-movie thrills | Cons: predictable story; thin characters; uneven suspense
